sourceInformation.audio: Original code-generated heroic jazz/synth music at 10% default, synthesized effects and wind, formant-synthesized Simlish-style voices; no audio files
sourceInformation.online: 1–2 cooperative shared city; AI Hub session integration; direct WebRTC invitation/reply connection
sourceInformation.testing: Unrestricted headless testing; scripted whole-mission playthrough, real WebGPU draw counters, keyboard/mouse, emulated standard gamepad and touch, two-page co-op, official AI Hub impaired-link/server/host-leave harness, offline audio analysis and 1920×1080 visual review. Physical controllers, real touch hardware and cross-network NAT traversal: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: 1979 Atari manual for mechanics, city/subway topology, crooks, bridge, kryptonite, transformation and finish; AtariAge screenshots for look; source sound descriptions; Three.js r180 source, Rapier docs, AI Hub protocol and harness

testingFeedback: Testing and review caught 19 tracked issues; see testing-issues.json in the development folder.

7 tracked issues were game-breaking or blocked multiplayer/deployment: unsafe HTML embedding, consumed remote actions, missing final win snapshot, unstable player identities, missing Hub metadata, software GPU device loss, and orphaned carried cargo after disconnect.
The full action-based mission playthrough, combined with real two-browser co-op and the official AI Hub harness, verified progression and exposed synchronization/ownership failures.
WebGPU canvas screenshots were least helpful because this host omitted the GPU canvas pixels. Real WebGPU draw counters verified rendering, and WebGL2 screenshots served as the visual stand-in.
engineFeedback: Three.js TSL color bands, the scene graph, and native AnimationMixer clips made a coherent procedural comic city possible.

aiHub.name: Super Delivery
aiHub.tagline: A city in pieces. A hero on the clock.
aiHub.description: Fly across an ink-outlined art deco city, recover three stolen bridge sections and deliver the Minus Gang to jail. Change back into a reporter and file the story, solo or with a second hero.
aiHub.controls: WASD move; Space fly/climb; Ctrl descend; Shift boost; E lift/use; Q scan; RMB orbit; Esc pause. Standard gamepad and assisted touch supported.
